payload.instruction: Turn the image into a drawing made from chalk
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

requirements.text: Turn the image into a drawing made from chalk
requirements.source_phrase: Turn the image into a drawing made from chalk

outcome.description: Transform the image into a chalk drawing.
outcome.target: The image is rendered as a drawing made from chalk, rather than merely showing an unrelated edit or a partial chalk effect.
outcome.reference: The input image and the edited image; compare whether the edited image has the appearance of a chalk-made drawing.

supports.question: Does the edited image show visual evidence of a chalk-like drawing treatment applied to the input image?
supports.criteria: Pass if the image visibly has a chalk-like drawing appearance; fail if there is sufficient evidence that it remains without a chalk-like drawing treatment; unknown if the image evidence is insufficient to determine this.
supports.binding: Compare the edited image with the input image for a chalk-like drawing appearance. Judge the visible result, not a particular technique; unrelated edits do not count as progress.

supports.question: Does the chalk-like drawing treatment transform the image as a whole, rather than appearing only as a partial effect?
supports.criteria: Pass if the image as a whole is rendered as a chalk-made drawing; fail if sufficient evidence shows no chalk-drawing progress, or only a partial chalk effect; unknown if the evidence cannot establish whether the transformation is complete or partial.
supports.binding: Assess the extent of the chalk-like drawing appearance across the image against the input image. Do not treat unrelated changes as progress or require a specific artistic technique.

parsed.fulfillment_criteria: Using only the support findings, mark complete if the image as a whole is rendered as a chalk-made drawing. Mark partial if there is evidence of some chalk-drawing progress but the whole-image transformation is incomplete. Mark absent if there is sufficient evidence of no requested chalk-drawing progress; unrelated edits alone are absent. Mark unknown when required evidence is insufficient or unresolved. A failed check does not by itself mean absent if another check establishes partial progress; unknown evidence remains unresolved.
